Whether you want to observe wildlife in your garden or protect your property turn your device into a motion detecting camera with live feed to your desktop. 

Motion Detector Cam Free uses a complex mathematical algorithm to spot movement and record a series of photos and video. To use simply start the app and place the device in a stationary position. 

You can now access a live camera feed from your desktop using an internet browser. 

Please note the device must be still to detect motion and take photos and video. To stop detecting motion simply pick up the device.

We recommend plugging your device into a power source for prolonged use.


- Features - 

Advanced motion detection with a single user defined parameter for tolerance (10 - 20 works well for most uses)

Live feed to your desktop.

If required set timers to enable/disable motion detection at predefined times

Photos and video saved to device camera roll. Photo resolution 720p. Video resolution 720p/1080p

Supports both front and rear cameras
